questions.stem: Select all neuroglial cells residing in Central Nervous System (CNS): (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: CNS neuroglia = Astrocytes, Oligodendrocytes, Microglia, Ependymal. Schwann = PNS.

questions.stem: Select all characteristics belonging to Red Muscle fibres: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Red muscle is rich in myoglobin/mitochondria, slow-twitch, aerobic.

questions.stem: Select all tissue macrophages derived from blood monocytes: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Kupffer, Microglia, Dust cells, Langerhans are monocyte-derived histocytes.

questions.stem: Select all features distinguishing Cardiac Muscle from Skeletal Muscle: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Cardiac muscle is involuntary, branched, has intercalated discs, fatigue-resistant.

questions.stem: Select all factors required during blood clotting cascade to form Fibrin: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Clotting requires Thromboplastin, Ca2+, Prothrombin, Thrombin, Fibrinogen.

questions.stem: Select all true features of White Adipose Tissue vs Brown Adipose Tissue: (Select all that apply)
options: A) White adipocytes are monolocular; Brown adipocytes are multilocular
B) Brown fat contains high density of cytochrome mitochondria
C) Brown fat expresses Thermogenin (UCP-1) for heat generation
D) White fat serves as primary long-term energy reservoir
E) White fat generates heat in hibernating newborn mammals
answers: A) White adipocytes are monolocular; Brown adipocytes are multilocular
B) Brown fat contains high density of cytochrome mitochondria
C) Brown fat expresses Thermogenin (UCP-1) for heat generation
D) White fat serves as primary long-term energy reservoir
questions.explanation: Brown fat is multilocular, rich in mitochondria/UCP-1 for thermogenesis; White fat is monolocular energy storage.

questions.stem: Select all ultrastructural events occurring in Sarcomere during Skeletal Muscle contraction: (Select all that apply)
options: B) Disappearance or narrowing of H-zone
E) Elongation of Myosin thick filaments
answers: B) Disappearance or narrowing of H-zone
questions.explanation: During contraction, I-band and H-zone shorten, Z-lines move closer, while A-band remains constant.

questions.stem: Select all structural characteristics of Myelinated Axons in peripheral nerves: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Concentric myelin wraps formed by Schwann cells
B) Saltatory action potential propagation across Nodes of Ranvier
C) High concentration of voltage-gated Na+ channels at Nodes
D) Increased nerve impulse conduction velocity
E) Continuous slow wave uninsulated axon depolarization
answers: A) Concentric myelin wraps formed by Schwann cells
B) Saltatory action potential propagation across Nodes of Ranvier
C) High concentration of voltage-gated Na+ channels at Nodes
D) Increased nerve impulse conduction velocity
questions.explanation: Myelinated nerve fibers feature Schwann myelin wraps, high Na+ channel density at Nodes, and fast saltatory conduction.

questions.stem: Select all properties distinguishing Fibrocartilage from Hyaline Cartilage: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Abundant parallel bundles of Type I collagen fibers
B) Highest tensile strength among all cartilage types
D) Located in intervertebral discs and pubic symphysis
E) Smooth glass-like transparent matrix with Type II collagen
answers: A) Abundant parallel bundles of Type I collagen fibers
B) Highest tensile strength among all cartilage types
D) Located in intervertebral discs and pubic symphysis
questions.explanation: Fibrocartilage has Type I collagen bundles, high tensile strength, lacks perichondrium, and forms intervertebral discs.

questions.stem: Select all cell types in Connective Tissue Proper derived from mesenchyme lineage: (Select all that apply)
options: C) Antibody-producing Plasma cells derived from B-lymphocytes
answers: C) Antibody-producing Plasma cells derived from B-lymphocytes
questions.explanation: Fibroblasts, Mast cells, Plasma cells, and Macrophages are mesenchymal connective tissue cells.
